events.text: For the booking diary: the practice is open Monday to Friday 08:30 to 17:30, and the Saturday clinic runs 09:00 to 16:00. We have Exam Room 1 and Exam Room 2 plus the small fitting room.

Booking policy from today: contact-lens follow-up appointments are booked as 30-minute slots, new-patient full exams as 45-minute slots, and every booking on a Saturday must have my approval before it is confirmed.
Confirming our current pricing for Clearview Optometry: trial contact lenses are 2.10 per pair, minimum order 40 pairs, delivery to your practice in three working days.

From September our returns pickup window at Clearview Optometry moves to 13:00 on Tuesdays and Thursdays.
Thought you might like our new fitting guide for your wall — it suggests allowing a comfortable 30 minutes per contact-lens follow-up so patients never feel rushed.

Booked Tom Bradley's contact-lens follow-up for Saturday 7 November 2026 at 15:30 in Exam Room 2 as a 30-minute slot. Martin Reeve approved the Saturday booking and I confirmed the appointment to Tom.
